newsitem.title: USA: Del Laboratories sets 4-for-3 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Del Laboratories sets 4-for-3 stock split.

text.p: Del Laboratories Inc said Tuesday its board has authorized a four-for-three split of its common stock.
The split is to be distributed to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 8, and will be paid out on November 29.
The board also approved an increase in the annual dividend rate on common stock to $0.1866 per share from $0.14 per share. The increase will amount to $0.14 per share on a post-split basis.

It will begin with the initial quarterly cash dividend payable following the current quarterly dividend of $0.35 per share, which will be paid on the pre-split shares on January 2, 1997, to shareholders of record as of November 1.
